subject: {Invitation}  Encord's AI Leaders Roundtable in Paris
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI will be hosting an intimate dinner with customers & AI leaders and we would like to invite you. 

Attendees range from Directors of Computer Vision & VPs of AI from larger orgs like AXA, Sanofi, etc as well as CEO's & CTO's of leading VC-backed start-ups such as Deepomatic, Scortex, etc

This intimate dinner will take place on 21st of May at the Maison de L'Amérique Latine restaurant where we have secured a private dining room for ~20 people, starting at 7pm.

subject: Recommendation from Ivan Vulic to improve data curation process
text:

subject: Woven's data curation solution
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've recently started working with Woven, Wayve, and Oxa - so thought it
could be interesting to reach out to explore if we can help at [COMPANY] in a
similar way.

The common challenges these teams faced were around existing data
visualisation / curation solutions (internal tools), lacking the speed &
scalability required to efficiently visualise their training datasets
(struggling beyond ~1m frames).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing
/ searching through billions of multimodal data items (using embeddings
visualisations, quality metric filters, & natural language searches),
enabling AV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning
from working with Woven, Wayve, Oxa and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?
